name: 99-Year-Old Port
summary: At Ratchet's docks, a bottle of 99-Year-Old Port has gone missing. Mad Magglish took it in a cargo spill and fled toward the Wailing Caverns.

sections.title: A High-Value Cargo Spill
sections.body: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz overloaded his crane while unloading a large shipment from Booty Bay in Ratchet. Crates crashed across the docks. In the confusion, Mad Magglish seized a bottle of 99-Year-Old Port and fled into the hills toward the Wailing Caverns.

sections.title: Diplomatic Vintage
sections.body: Baron Revilgaz of the Blackwater Raiders sent the port to Gazlowe, Ratchet’s chief engineer and ruler, as a diplomatic gift. Its loss threatens Bigglefuzz’s livelihood and strains relations with the dockmaster. Mad Magglish lurks in the outer grottos of the caverns with the unopened bottle. The dockhands seek mercenaries to recover it before Gazlowe learns of the blunder.

faq.q: Who was the 99-Year-Old Port originally meant for?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz, master of Booty Bay, sent the bottle as a personal gift to Gazlowe, Ratchet’s boss.

faq.q: How did Mad Magglish end up with the port?
faq.answer: Bigglefuzz overloaded his crane while unloading cargo, scattering crates across Ratchet’s docks. Mad Magglish seized the bottle amid the confusion and ran.

faq.q: Where did Mad Magglish take the bottle?
faq.answer: Magglish fled inland across the Barrens and hid in the rocky antechambers and outer tunnels leading into the Wailing Caverns.

faq.q: Why didn't Bigglefuzz retrieve the port himself?
faq.answer: Bigglefuzz pursued Magglish to the threshold of the Wailing Caverns, but refused to enter. He feared the beasts and corrupted druids inside.

angles.text: Mad Magglish uses amateur stealth to hide in the dark outside the Wailing Caverns. As a rogue, you can flush him from the shadows.
